lessons.title: Advanced vocabulary
lessons.objective: Build championship-level understanding of advanced vocabulary and apply it accurately to unfamiliar problems.
lessons.core_teaching_content: Advanced English combines vocabulary, grammar, close reading, argument, literary technique and precise editing. Interpret language in context and support claims with textual evidence. Distractors often contain a true statement that fails to answer the exact question. Focus specifically on advanced vocabulary. Identify the core ideas, common traps, evidence or procedure needed to justify an answer, and the verification step that protects against careless errors. Practise moving from recognition to application: identify the task, select a method, execute it carefully, and check the result against all constraints. Record errors by cause so revision targets the underlying weakness.
examples: A National English Championship problem on advanced vocabulary should begin by identifying the exact clue or condition that determines the method.
Create a new advanced vocabulary problem with a plausible distractor and explain why the correct solution satisfies every condition.
lessons.practical_activity: Complete a focused National English Championship activity on advanced vocabulary using a worked problem, comparison table, diagram, passage or data set as appropriate.
lessons.guided_practice: Work through three scaffolded tasks on advanced vocabulary: model the first, prompt the second, and require an independent solution to the third with explicit justification.
independent_practice: Solve three unfamiliar advanced vocabulary questions without viewing solutions.
Create and solve one new challenge using the lesson principle.
Analyse one error and state the rule that would prevent it next time.
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Complete an eight-item National English Championship checkpoint on advanced vocabulary; target at least six correct and justify every uncertain answer.
lessons.student_task: Produce one finished championship task demonstrating advanced vocabulary and show the reasoning or evidence used.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Coach for precise definitions, explicit reasoning and independent verification. Do not replace productive struggle with immediate answers. Suitable for self-learning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one strength, one recurring error and one measurable action for improving advanced vocabulary.
lessons.daily_flow: Learn → Worked Example → Guided Challenge → Independent Practice → Check → Reflect
